purpose: 检验同义改写、无指标名公式、近邻概念和对象/层级变化；不用于生产Prompt，不代表跨文档业务准确率。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The portfolio aims to achieve long term capital growth. The portfolio shall maintain low Tracking Error against its benchmark.
cases.reason: 增长对应收益概念、低TE对应跟踪误差；不支持额外风险调整或条件Beta。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The portfolio shall measure Cov(Rp, Rb | Rb < 0) / Var(Rb | Rb < 0), where Rp and Rb are daily portfolio and benchmark returns. This sensitivity must not exceed 0.8.
cases.reason: 没有指标名但条件协方差/方差公式明确，不能要求字面downside beta。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
Only observations on dates when the benchmark return is negative shall be used.

Compute the covariance of portfolio and benchmark daily returns on those dates, divided by the variance of benchmark daily returns on the same dates. The resulting sensitivity shall be at most 0.8.
cases.reason: 同一条件公式的正文改写和换行不改变概念。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The equity portfolio's exposure to any single security shall not exceed 10% of total portfolio assets.
cases.reason: 按证券计量，不汇总同发行人全部证券。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The bond portfolio's aggregate exposure to any single issuer, combining all securities issued by that issuer, shall not exceed 10% of total portfolio assets.
cases.reason: 改成发行人聚合后应切换指标，不把security与issuer当同义词。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The aggregate exposure to any individual GICS sector shall not exceed 20% of the portfolio market value.
cases.reason: 绝对行业集中度在当前目录缺口，不能以相对行业偏离度顶替。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
For each equity sector, the portfolio sector weight minus the benchmark sector weight must remain between -5 and +5 percentage points.
cases.reason: 加入减基准操作后才是行业偏离度。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
Before investing in a third-party managed fund, verify that more than 5% of that fund's underlying assets can be liquidated within one day and more than 20% within seven days.
cases.reason: 第三方基金底层准入条件不能改成全组合上市权益占比。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The portfolio must measure the market value of its listed equities that can be liquidated within seven trading days as a percentage of the market value of all listed equities in the portfolio. Use the previous three months' average daily trading volume and a 10% participation rate.
cases.reason: 全组合上市权益、分母、7交易日和10%参与率均明确。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The investment objective is to earn a stable dividend yield, measured as annual cash dividends divided by the market value of the equity investment.
cases.reason: 库内股息贡献率、NII/账面值、增长率和组合/基准股息率比值都不能替代该收益率。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The equity portfolio shall measure Rp - [Rf + beta * (Rm - Rf)], where Rf is the risk-free return, Rm is market return and beta is the portfolio's market sensitivity. This risk-adjusted return must be positive.
cases.reason: 明确CAPM调整公式，不是普通Rp-Rb超额收益，也不因beta只是公式操作数而额外选组合Beta。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The bond portfolio shall normally hold assets to maturity. The manager may divest assets when adjustment of the portfolio's duration is necessary. No numerical duration target is specified.
cases.reason: 实际管理调整明确使用久期，不能因无数字上限而漏选；也不自动引入DV01或平均剩余期限。

cases.text:
[Page 1]
The investment objective is to increase the long-run value of invested capital through equity investment.
cases.reason: 资本增长目标改写仍对应收益概念，不是必须逐字出现指标名或数字上限。
